questions.text: Which closure conditions of plan section 7.1 must be machine-checked, and what exact rejection set do the hostile cases of CP-00 define?
completion_criteria: Every closure condition maps to one validator rule id with a positive and a hostile subprocess test.

questions.text: Where must the validator execute, given the DevForge trust boundary and the frozen Research CLI contract of exactly ten operations?
completion_criteria: An invocation that changes no frozen contract, ships in the staging wheel, and maps to the future protected DevForge command, accepted by the decision authority.

questions.text: How is explicitly external evidence represented so that repository-relative path escape is rejected while out-of-repository evidence stays admissible?
completion_criteria: A schema field and a validator rule, with the plan's own run-5 inputs passing and a hostile absolute path failing.

questions.text: What does reviewer independence mean when identities are self-reported record fields?
completion_criteria: A rule that rejects self-review, and a recorded limitation stating what the rule cannot establish.

questions.text: What definitions make the hostile cases 'unbounded limitation' and 'empty or non-concrete reopen_if' testable?
completion_criteria: A written definition in decisions.md and a hostile test that matches it exactly.

intended_downstream_use: The CP-00 work PR: checkpoint schema, semantic validator, initial records, tests, and this dossier; later checkpoints close only through the validator.

hypotheses.label: UNVERIFIED_HYPOTHESIS
hypotheses.text: Every section 7.1 closure condition can be checked deterministically from the record, the plan README, the dossier manifest, and Git ancestry, without a model in the loop.

include: Plan sections 5, 6, 7, 9 and 12 as closure rules
Repository contracts that bound where a validator may live
Owner decisions on the DevForge trust boundary and the validator invocation
exclude: Review-skill generation, installer expansion, evidence export

freshness_requirements: PRIMARY sources are repository files read at base commit 6a446355605a06891cdeab1cc9d25f35309afba2 and digested, or decisions recorded by the decision authority on 2026-09-04; model memory is not a source.

completion_criteria: Every question has a terminal disposition.
The validator rejects every hostile case named by CP-00 and accepts one complete synthetic record and this repository's fifteen open records.
Every claim is either independently verified or marked not accepted.
stop_conditions: Stop if a required repository contract would have to change to place the validator.
